tests.name: the unit suite is green on head, including the unchanged maintenance, admin tasks and schema version unit tests and the schema version build test; CI test:int on the same head, with the migrations applied from scratch, passes each of these tests of packages/core/src/plt/claim-barrier.int.test.ts under its exact title, none missing or skipped: "B01 barrier inactive: an old-code claim that writes no generation or build passes unchanged"; "B02 barrier active: a claim with a NULL generation or build is rejected"; "B03 barrier active: a generation or build left by an earlier claim does not authorize a claim that does not write it"; "B04 barrier active: a claim with a build outside the allowed build set is rejected"; "B05 barrier active: a new job is claimed with the current generation and an allowed build"; "B06 barrier active: a job the new build claimed before activation loses authority at the token rotation and continues only by a new claim"; "B07 activation fails and changes nothing when the allowed build set is empty"; "B08 activation fails and changes nothing when the current build is not in the allowed build set"; "B09 activation is idempotent: a second call with the same input raises no generation and rotates no token"; "B10 deactivation turns the barrier off without deleting data, and an old-code claim passes again"; "B11 the activation and deactivation functions are not executable by public, anon or authenticated"; "B12 instant rollback: a pre-barrier build is rejected and a post-barrier build claims only after the allowed build row is updated"; "B13 a held old runner can neither claim, complete, fail nor record an effect on a guarded path after activation"; "B14 payload version requeue: a job of a higher payload version returns to the queue with no net attempt and a later run_at"; "B15 a job of an unknown kind is not claimed"; "B16 barrier active: an empty or NULL allowed build set rejects every claim"; the same CI test:int also passes every test of packages/core/src/plt/lease-generation.int.test.ts, none removed, skipped or marked todo (E297-R)
